# laravelforge_server_backup_configuration (Resource)

Manages a database backup configuration (schedule, retention, storage provider) on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the databases to back up. Write-only input (not round-tripped into state).
- `frequency` (String) Backup frequency: `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, or `custom`.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `retention` (Number) Number of backups to retain.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the backup configuration belongs to.
- `storage_provider_id` (Number) ID of the storage provider (credential) the backups are written to.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) Storage bucket the backups are written to.
- `cron` (String) Custom cron expression (used when `frequency` is `custom`). Write-only input.
- `day` (String) Day of week for weekly backups (`0`-`6`). Write-only input.
- `directory` (String) Directory within the bucket.
- `name` (String) Name of the backup configuration.
- `notification_email` (String) Email address notified on backup events. Write-only input; the API reports it back as `notify_email`.
- `time` (String) Time of day the backup runs (e.g. `03:00`).

### Read-Only

- `cloud_provider` (String) Underlying storage provider (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).
- `cron_schedule` (String) Custom cron schedule, if `frequency` is `custom`.
- `day_of_week` (Number) Day of week the backup runs (`0`-`6`), if weekly.
- `displayable_schedule` (String) Human-readable schedule.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the backup configuration.
- `next_run_time` (String) Timestamp of the next scheduled run.
- `notify_email` (String) Email address notified on backup events.
- `schedule` (String) Resolved cron schedule.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
